mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_agent_model_access access JOIN bike_agent access_agent ON access_agent.id=access.agent_id AND access_agent.status='ENABLED' JOIN bike_product_model access_model ON access_model.id=access.model_id AND access_model.enabled=1 WHERE access.agent_id=#{agentId} AND access.model_id=#{modelId} AND access.enabled=1)
mapper.select: SELECT model_id FROM bike_agent_model_access WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND enabled=1 ORDER BY model_id
SELECT id FROM bike_agent WHERE id=#{agentId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_product_model WHERE enabled=1 AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_agent_model_access SET enabled=0 WHERE agent_id=#{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_agent_model_access(agent_id,model_id,enabled) VALUES(#{agentId},#{modelId},1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE enabled=1
